concerns.text: The plan asserts that the full pipeline will complete within the GitHub Actions free‑tier limits (≤ 6 h, 2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM). Running Llama‑2‑7B 8‑bit via Ollama on CPU for up to 200 multi‑hop tasks may exceed this budget, especially if average tool‑call sequences are long. Consider providing a concrete runtime estimate (e.g., average inference time per call) or reducing the max‑tasks limit to ensure the 6 h constraint is reliably met.
